zh.title: 美國FAA核發波音737-7修正型別證 清除商業營運障礙
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空管理局已授予波音737-7飛機修正型別證，為該機型投入商業服務清除障礙。波音與啟動客戶西南航空正準備交付首架飛機。FAA同時更新波音第700號生產證書以納入737-7。
body: 美國聯邦航空管理局已授予波音737-7飛機修正型別證，為該機型投入商業服務清除障礙。波音於2026年8月3日宣布此項消息。
波音商用飛機總裁兼執行長Stephanie Pope表示，這項認證驗證了飛機設計的嚴謹性，並肯定了737 MAX開發團隊的決心與韌性。她指出，團隊在面對挑戰、疫情以及新認證流程轉換的過程中，始終專注於完成所有要求並交付更安全、能力更強的飛機。
737-7是737 MAX家族中最小且航程最遠的成員，在雙艙等配置下可搭載135至160名乘客，航程可達3,800海里（約7,040公里）。與其通常取代的飛機相比，737-7可減少20%的燃油消耗與二氧化碳排放，噪音足跡減少50%。
認證測試計畫始於2018年，包含超過1,000小時的飛行與地面測試、廣泛的系統安全分析與人因審查，以及更新引擎防冰系統以解決飛行測試中發現的潛在狀況。產品策略與開發資深副總裁Mike Sinnett表示，波音團隊與FAA保持定期且詳細的討論，確保理解各項要求並提供進展的透明度。
波音與737-7啟動客戶西南航空正準備交付首架飛機，團隊已就緒首批飛機，包括實施飛機最終構型的更新。FAA同時更新波音第700號生產證書（PC 700）以納入737-7。
截至2026年6月底，737 MAX家族訂單簿超過7,200架，其中已交付超過2,300架。波音另表示正致力於今年完成737-10的認證。

en.title: U.S. FAA Grants Boeing Amended Type Certificate for 737-7, Clearing It for Commercial Service
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration has granted Boeing an amended type certificate for the 737-7 airplane, clearing it for commercial service. Boeing and launch customer Southwest Airlines are preparing for delivery of the first airplane. The FAA also updated Boeing Production Certificate No. 700 to include the 737-7.
body: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration has granted Boeing an amended type certificate for the new 737-7 airplane, clearing it for commercial service. Boeing announced the certification on August 3, 2026.

Stephanie Pope, president and CEO of Boeing Commercial Airplanes, said the certification validates the rigor of the airplane's design and recognizes the determination and resilience of the 737 MAX development team. She noted that the team worked through challenges, an extended pandemic, and the transition to new certification processes while staying focused on completing all requirements and delivering a safe, more capable airplane.

The 737-7 is the smallest and longest-range member of the 737 MAX family, seating 135 to 160 passengers in a two-class configuration with a range of up to 3,800 nautical miles (7,040 km). Compared to the airplanes it typically replaces, the 737-7 reduces fuel use and CO2 emissions by 20% and its noise footprint by 50%.

The certification test program began in 2018 and included more than 1,000 hours of flight and ground testing, extensive system safety analysis and human factors reviews, and an updated engine anti-ice system to address a potential condition discovered during flight testing. Mike Sinnett, senior vice president of Product Strategy, Product Development and Development Programs, said Boeing held regular and detailed discussions with the FAA to ensure understanding of requirements and transparency of progress.

Boeing and Southwest Airlines, the 737-7 launch customer, are preparing for delivery of the first airplane. A team is readying the first airplanes, including implementing updates to the airplane's final configuration. The FAA also updated Boeing Production Certificate No. 700 (PC 700) to include the 737-7.

The 737 MAX family order book stands at more than 7,200 airplanes, of which more than 2,300 have been delivered through the end of June 2026. Boeing also stated it is working to certify the 737-10 this year.
